problem.title: The treatment plan is ready. <highlight>The budget is not always.</highlight>
problem.text: When patient contributions rise, recommended services may be postponed, reduced or not started at all. Healio helps patients understand which reimbursement and bonus options may be available to them – without influencing the practice's medical decision.

budget.title: The <highlight>Healio health budget</highlight>
budget.subtitle: Depending on the tariff and personal eligibility, patients may be able to use up to EUR 3,000 in tariff benefits over two years. The IKK bonus does not come on top. It can help with the premium for the supplementary cover, up to EUR 810 a year under the statutes, depending on documented activities.
budget.totalDesc: potential tariff benefits over two years; the IKK bonus is assessed separately
budget.naturheilkundeDesc: Tariff benefits for services including naturopathy, osteopathy, TCM and chiropractic care
budget.sehhilfenDesc: SDK tariff benefit for vision aids, reimbursed at 100% in every tier up to the pot limit. A potential IKK bonus can help carry the premium for it.
budget.footnote: The actual amount and availability depend, among other things, on the selected tariff, its conditions and documented bonus activities.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the <highlight>partnership</highlight>
faq.subtitle: Responsibilities, benefits and requirements explained clearly.

items.question: What exactly is the Healio health budget?
items.answer: It means the tariff benefits of an outpatient supplementary insurance. In the strongest tariff that is up to EUR 3,000 over two years, split into four benefit pots. A health insurer bonus is not included. It is checked separately and, depending on the insurer and activities, can help with the premium. Healio checks individual eligibility.

items.question: Do I commit to anything with the partnership?
items.answer: No. Healio provides information materials and displays. Whether and where you use them is up to you after the introductory meeting.

items.question: Do I have to explain or recommend insurance?
items.answer: No. Your role is limited to providing neutral information. Healio handles the individual check, insurance advice, brokerage and application support directly with the interested patient.

items.question: Which services may be reimbursed?
items.answer: Depending on the tariff, benefits may include naturopathy, osteopathy, TCM, chiropractic care, vision aids and dental services. Scope, waiting periods and reimbursement conditions are always determined by the selected tariff.

items.question: Do I have to change my practice concept?
items.answer: No. Treatment, pricing and professional decisions remain entirely with you. Healio only adds a neutral information path for patients who wish to review their funding options.

items.question: How are the vision aid benefits structured?
items.answer: The SDK reimburses vision aids at 100% in every tier, up to EUR 500 over two calendar years in the strongest tariff. Separately, an IKK bonus from documented activities can lower the premium for the supplementary cover. It is not a flat-rate glasses subsidy.

moral.title: Good information strengthens the relationship with your patients.
moral.text1: Many patients want to continue their treatment but are held back by out-of-pocket costs. A neutral introduction to possible health-insurance bonuses and suitable supplementary cover gives them another basis for an informed decision.
moral.text2: Your role stays clear: you treat and inform. Healio explains the financial options and supports interested patients with the next steps.
moral.text3: This creates value without sales pressure: your patients know their options, and you decide how the information pathway fits into your practice.
